observations: Five open-mouthed faces are distributed across the canvas, each ringed by spiky radiating lines; the central figure is the largest and sits against a near-black ground.
A pink six-petaled flower floats above the central figure, and a yellow spiral occupies the upper right, providing two rounded, calm shapes inside otherwise dense, jagged mark-making.
Deep red and black cover most of the field, with bursts of sky blue, gold, and white lines concentrating brightness around each face's eye area.
reading: Five open-mouthed faces crowd the picture plane, each ringed by spiky lines that read as agitation or alarm. The near-black ground presses them forward while white lines trace their features with quick, scratchy strokes. A lone pink flower and a yellow spiral sit above the central figure—small, rounded forms that feel oddly quiet against the surrounding noise. The image holds both menace and absurdity at once.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #181 and nnxyz nnotb #183. Where #181 isolates a single face on saturated yellow and #183 spreads figures across warm amber, #182 packs the most faces into the darkest ground of the three, making white line-work stand out sharply.

connections.reason: Both #182 and #183 arrange multiple open-mouthed figures side by side with spiky radiating lines around each head, but #183 uses a warm amber ground while #182 uses near-black, reversing the light-dark relationship.
nifty faces #7 shares the concentric-spiral eye construction and white-line face-building visible in #182's central figure, though #7 fills its ground with red rather than black.
